title: Fighter pilot from Chile meets an object clocked at 25,000 km/h

tellings.quote: One of them, for example, was a pilot that was flying from Chile to Brazil, flying a fighter jet.

plain: Aldo Rebello, described as Brazil's defense minister, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about several cases in Brazil's records of unexplained objects. One of them, he says, involved a pilot flying a fighter jet from Chile to Brazil in the 1980s who met an object that was measured moving at about 25,000 kilometres an hour. If true, that would be a speed far beyond any known aircraft.
